project.title: Glycoproteomics reveals the presence of decorin peptides with anti-myostatin activity in human atrial fibrillation
project.projectDescription: We analysed by proteomics the cardiac extraceelular matrix in human atrial fibrillation and disvovered the presence of extracellular matrix protein fragments that can regulate cardiac cell physiology
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were extracted using a 3-step protocol for extracellular matrix protein enrichment. Proteins were deglycosylated and run in Bis-tris gels. After trypsin digestion, proteins were identified using LC-MS/MS in an Orbitrap XL instrument.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MS data were searched using Mascot agains a human database 12013_08

references.referenceLine: Barallobre-Barreiro J, Gupta SK, Zoccarato A, Kitazume-Taneike R, Fava M, Yin X, Werner T, Hirt MN, Zampetaki A, Viviano A, Chong M, Bern M, Kourliouros A, Domenech N, Willeit P, Shah AM, Jahangiri M, Schaefer L, Fischer JW, Iozzo RV, Viner R, Thum T, Heineke J, Kichler A, Otsu K, Mayr M. Glycoproteomics Reveals Decorin Peptides With Anti-Myostatin Activity in Human Atrial Fibrillation. Circulation. 2016 Sep 13;134(11):817-32
